articleTitle: Cloud Computing Task Scheduling Policy Based on Improved Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The task scheduling policy is the important factors for achieving efficient calculation in a cloud computing environment. This article put forwards a task scheduling method based on improved particle swarm algorithm against the present inefficiency. Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm is used to solve task scheduling optimization by introducing the iterative selection operator. Improved particle swarm optimization algorithm (IPSO) can improve the ability of the optimization, as much as possible avoiding falling into a local optimum. The convergence effect is so better that the task scheduling time costs can be reduced. By simulation on a CloudSim simulation platform, the experimental results show that the algorithm has the advantages of improving optimization and taking less time. So it can be used to research and practice about cloud computing problem for complex scheduling optimization.

articleTitle: Computer Vision Imaging Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to study artificial intelligence-based computer vision imaging, computer technology was used to efficiently and accurately obtain relevant information from environmental images or videos. Things and phenomena in the objective world were analyzed, judged, and decided. Based on biological vision and physical models, the basic methods and approaches of computer vision were explored. The contents of evolutionary calculations, pattern recognition, biological vision, and surface defects detection of slabs were studied. A computer vision system with high adaptability, high accuracy, and rapid response was developed. The results showed that the evolutionary calculation methods were diverse in form and versatile. Therefore, it can be applied in many aspects of computer vision, and its performance is very good.

articleTitle: An Improved Hybrid Group Intelligent Algorithm Based on Artificial Bee Colony and Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Aiming at the disadvantage of poor convergence performance of PSO and artificial swarm algorithm, an improved hybrid algorithm is proposed to overcome the shortcomings of complex optimization problems. Through the test of four standard function by hybrid algorithm and compared the result with standard particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm and Artificial Bee Colony (ABC) algorithm, the convergence rate and convergence precision of the hybrid algorithm are both superior to those of the standard particle swarm algorithm and Artificial Bee Colony algorithm, presenting a better optimal performance.

articleTitle: An Analysis of the Current Status and Countermeasures of Bike-Sharing in the Background of Internet
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: With the continuous rapid growth of China's overall economy, the role of urban transport in social and economic development has become increasingly significant. However, it also brings a series of problems, such as the impact of transport on the environment, which have received more attention. As one of the ways of low-carbon transportation, Bike-sharing have attracted widespread attention in the society in recent years. The Bike-sharing has played an irreplaceable role in solving the problem of the "last mile" trip in the city. By exploring the characteristics of Bike-sharing, the problems existing in the social, enterprise and individual aspects of development are discussed. Then, the selection of Bike-sharing station and design of Bike-sharing are taken as the starting point for consideration and prospects for the later research work.

articleTitle: A Principal Component Analysis Approach to Noise Removal for Speech Denoising
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: There is still remnant noise which affects the quality of speech data after traditional speech signal denoising for the speech data. In order to improve the effect of speech signal denoising, a speech denoising method based on the principal component analysis was proposed. Firstly? an embedded matrix that contains all information of collection signals is obtained by using dynamic embedded (Dynamic embedding, DE) technology in order to meet the needs of the principle of principal component analysis. Secondly, the principal components of speech signal are transformed through the principle of principal component analysis. By analyzing the principal components of speech signal, the low order principal components which associated with the big eigenvalues reflect the correlated speech signals could be selected to reconstruct the speech data. The required number of principal components is determined based on the Bayesian information criterion. Finally, the speech data are reconstructed by suitable number of the low-order components to remove the uncorrelated noise. In order to prove the effectiveness of the denoising algorithm, several experiments are conducted by the traditional filtering algorithm and the algorithm of this paper. All of the results indicate that the de-noising algorithm based on principal component analysis can achieve a better effect. And the signal waveform of the principal component denoising method is more full and more close to the original speech signal.

articleTitle: Research on Anomaly Intrusion Detection Technology in Wireless Network
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to improve the security of wireless network, an anomaly intrusion detection algorithm based on adaptive time-frequency feature decomposition is proposed. This paper analyzes the types and detection principles of wireless network intrusion detection, it adopts the information statistical analysis method to detect the network intrusion, constructs the traffic statistical analysis model of the network abnormal intrusion, and establishes the network intrusion signal model by combining the signal fitting method. The correlation matching filter is used to filter the network intrusion signal to improve the output signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), the time-frequency analysis method is used to extract the characteristic quantity of the network abnormal intrusion, and the adaptive correlation spectrum analysis method is used to realize the intrusion detection. The simulation results show that this method has high accuracy and strong anti-interference ability, and it can effectively guarantee the network security.

articleTitle: Exploration of Computer Emotion Decision Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: To carry out the discussion of computer emotion decision based on artificial intelligence, first of all, based on the psychological experiment paradigm of children's game task, and the test process of the artificial emotion generating engine was completed on the emotional spontaneous transfer and the stimulus transfer model. Secondly, the reasoning method and analytic hierarchy process (AHP) were introduced into the multi system, and a kind of multi emotion decision model based on the emotion reasoning was constructed. The hierarchical structure method was used to solve the complex decision problem of the humanoid robot in the intelligent home environment. Then, based on the emotion energy theory, a mood state regulation algorithm based on the combination of HMM-based spontaneous transfer and stimulus transfer was established. In addition, on this basis, the design and implementation of humanoid robot associative memory model was realized. Finally, the theory and algorithm were integrated into the interactive platform of human-computer expression, and the validity of the model was analysed and verified. The results showed that, on this robot platform, the process of human-computer interaction and cooperation which integrated emotion evaluation, emotional decision, associative memory and emotion regulation was realized. As a result, the computer emotion decision based on artificial intelligence can be well applied in many fields.

articleTitle: A Novel English Speech Recognition Approach Based on Hidden Markov Model
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to promote English teaching quality, English speech recognition has been attracted more and more attention. In this paper, we aim to propose a novel English speech recognition approach based on Hidden Markov model. Particularly, the English speech recognition problem can be described as seeking the most suitable word sequence based on a segment of English voice. Furthermore, using the Hidden Markov model, English speech recognition problem can be converted to find a word sequence, which is translated to a sequence of Hidden Markov model. To promote the performance of the standard Hidden Markov model, we propose a HMM-based semi-nonparametric method to enhance the performance of the accuracy of English speech recognition. Probabilistic transition frequency profile matrix and average probabilistic emission matrix are calculated for all training word sequences. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed English speech recognition approach can achieve higher recognition rate than the related works.

Author Keywords: English speech recognition, Hidden Markov model, Conditional probability, Word sequence

articleTitle: Application of a Multi-factor Linear Regression Model for Stock Portfolio Optimization
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Multi-factor models of asset pricing indicate a linear relationship between the expected return of assets while exposing to one or more risks. In this study, the sensitivity of portfolio returns to 4 selected macroeconomic factors (Market Performance, Real GDP, Inflation, Unemployment) were examined by means of multiple linear regression analyses with regard to multi-factors. Experiments show that the generalized approach of moment estimators of risk premiums lead to better results on individual assets over historical averages. Especially when the factors are weakly correlated with assets which indicates that the factors selected should be less correlated with each other.

Author Keywords: Factor Pricing Models, Optimization Model, Linear Regression

articleTitle: A Software Test Case Automatic Generation Technology Based on the Modified Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: As the software project has been more and more complex than ever, software test case automatic generation is of great importance for software testing. In this paper, we aim to propose a novel software test case automatic generation technology to promote the quality of software testing. The main innovation of this paper lies in that we introduce the PSO algorithm to generate software case. Particularly, in order to enhance the performance of PSO, we propose an improved PSO algorithm, in which the position and velocity of each particle represented as vectors in the multiple dimensional binary solution space. Afterwards, a novel software test case automatic generation algorithm based on PSO is proposed. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm is able to obtain both high performance and lower time cost in software test case automatic generation.

Author Keywords: Software test case, Automatic generation, Particle swarm optimization, Random number

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis Method of Power System Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The power system is disturbed by electromagnetic interference and crosstalk between the transmission link layers in the transmission and distribution process, and it is easy to produce transmission distribution fault. In order to improve the efficiency of fault diagnosis, a method of fault diagnosis for power system based on neural network algorithm is proposed. The multi sensor quantization fusion method is used to carry out electricity. The transmission distribution signal in the power transmission link layer is extracted from the power system, and the transmission distribution signal is decomposed and the association rules are excavated. The spectral analysis model is used to extract the spectral characteristics of the transmission information of the power system, and the fault diagnosis and fault type identification are carried out according to the spectrum difference. The power system fault features are classified and identified by neural network learning algorithm to realize the optimal diagnosis of power system fault. The simulation results show that the method is more accurate and more efficient in the fault diagnosis of power system.

articleTitle: Online Bookstore Management System Based on Android
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: This system is an e-commerce platform, and it is an APP developed on the basis of Android. Android Studio and cloud service platform Bmob are used as tools to develop. When you read a good book, you can see others and see yourself, and you can get a lot of insights every time. Reading is a very popular thing to do. No matter how busy a job is, people will spend a certain amount of time buying books and reading books. The APP design page is beautiful, friendly user interface, high user experience, on the online bookstore APP, buyers and bookstore managers can achieve their own needs. Book purchasers can quickly buy their favorite books. Bookstore administrators can deal with orders formed after book buyers' books in the first time and update books in bookstores in time. The development of such APP is of great significance for economic development, and much more convenient for consumers to use.

articleTitle: Research on Internet of Things Middleware Technology for Laboratory Environmental Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The Internet of things is an important technology for computer network, and it is of great importance for the information era. In this paper, we aim to integrate the Internet of things and middleware technology together to effectively monitor laboratory environment. Currently, IoT related researches can be classified to three directions: such as Internet-oriented, things-oriented, and semantic-oriented. Afterwards, the structure of the IoT middleware for laboratory environmental monitoring is provided, which contains: Information gateway, Security component, Routing component, Message queue, and so on. Finally, experimental results demonstrate that the proposed Internet of things middleware technology can monitor the light and sound in the laboratory environment with high accuracy.

Author Keywords: Internet of Things, Middleware, Laboratory environmental monitoring, Radio frequency identification, Wireless sensor network

articleTitle: Development and Implementation of Learning System of an Intelligent Learning System for Ideological and Political Education in Colleges under Mobile Platform
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Construction of mobile virtual platform under ideological and political education 2.0 starts the innovation of communication upgrading and organization pattern. Therefore, this paper analyzes the technology and demand feasibility of mobile learning platform developing to establish an intelligent learning system for the demand features of mobile learning platform. We propose and design Android based hybrid architecture mode for intelligent mobile learning platform, and design the prototype of mobile learning front-end platform. The system tests analysis show the intelligent system provides a novel approach for the teaching implementation of ideological and political education in colleges under mobile model, which has strong practicality and reference value.

articleTitle: Improving Artificial Bee Colony and Particle Swarm Optimization to Solve TSP Problem
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to solve the complex scale problem of traveling salesman, this paper puts forward a kind of swarm intelligent hybrid algorithm of combination of artificial bee colony and particle swarm algorithm and introduces artificial immune algorithm. In order to overcome the problem of large scale TSP apt to be trapped in local optima, it has powerful ability of global searching and better search convergence. The simulation experimental data comparison shows that the improved hybrid algorithm searches results better than the similar algorithms, and it has satisfactory results applied in large scale TSP.

articleTitle: Reliability Evaluation of Distribution Network Considering Distributed Intermittent Renewable Energy Access
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Aiming at the randomness of distributed power output power, a common method and index system for reliability evaluation of distribution network with intermittent renewable DG is first established; then the reliability calculation model of distribution network containing DG is established, and the reliability index of load point after island formation is analyzed combined with the island operation mode of distribution network; the power supply reliability of distribution network containing DG is analyzed and calculated by the traditional fault consequence analysis method and the minimum path algorithm. The IEEE-RBTS test system with DG is simulated and calculated, the results show that DG can improve the power supply reliability of the distribution network after reasonable access to the distribution network, and different DG reliability models have different effects on the reliability index.

articleTitle: Research on Genetic Neural Network Algorithm and Its Application
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The traditional BP neural network has a slow convergence speed and requires a long training time; it is easy to fall into a local optimum; the network is always of high redundancy; the learning and memory of the network are unstable. This paper uses a genetic algorithm to modify weights and thresholds of the neural network in order to obtain the global optimal value. The simulation results show that this method has the characteristics of strong detection ability of pollution concentration and high detection efficiency, which can help improve the accuracy and speed of detection of SO2 pollution concentration in urban air.

articleTitle: Development and Implementation of College Ideological and Political Education Learning System under Mobile Platform
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: To solve the problems of low teaching efficiency and students' passive acceptance of ideological and political education in traditional teaching mode, this article design and develop an ideological and political education system based on Android. First, the system demand and function design are analyzed to explain the design idea of mobile learning system. Then, the key technologies of this system of mobile development is discussed, including Android system, MVP design mode, mobile live broadcast, instant messaging, three party sharing, message push, network access and so on. Finally the function realization and construction of development environment are realized and the tests results indicate the learning platform achieves the expected object.

articleTitle: Research of Cloud Platform Data Encryption Technology Based on ECC Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Information security degree under the environment of cloud computing platform directly affect the user's data security problem, and the use of encryption algorithm that provides superior characteristics can make up for disadvantages caused by relying on software security strategy, which is more effective and stable to overcome the difficulty and challenge faced by the information security. In this paper, through studying the basic thoughts of the elliptic curve encryption algorithm, an optimized method from the aspect of dynamic is designed based on elliptic curve encryption algorithm of cloud data protection technology to ensure the system running safely and efficiently, and the safety test is made in Matlab software. Experimental results show that the designed cloud data encryption technology based on ECC algorithm has high security and running speed, and it can effectively protect the security and stability of cloud platform data.

articleTitle: College English Assisted Teaching Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The problem to be solved in artificial intelligence (AI) is considered to discuss the application of AI technology in English teaching, and a college English assisted instruction system based on expert system is designed in this paper. The expert system module for teacher assisted English teaching is based on expert system theory, and the knowledge representation of domain knowledge is made by integrating production and framework. According to uncertain fuzzy inference analysis, teachers can understand the mastery of students' knowledge points. Instruction teaching adopts neural network to establish student autonomous learning system module, which is used to analyze the student test situation and perform self diagnosis. The experimental results show that the system can help teachers grasp the learning situation of students through reasoning analysis, and enable students to learn autonomously with good application value.

articleTitle: Fault Prediction for Satellite Communication Equipment Based on Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of fault prediction for satellite communication system, a prediction model based on deep learning is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the equipment parameters are summed up, and then two kinds of states covering normal and abnormal situations are determined. After feature learning, self-encoding network is used to obtain new features which can characterize the deep feature of the data. Then the tagged data extracted from monitoring equipment are applied to train the prediction classifier which is the combination of deep belief network and softmax classifier. The deep belief network is composed of limited Boltzmann machine as well as BP network. BP network is used for parameters adjustment. Finally, the effects of fault prediction including the performance of model and average prediction accuracy are tested through simulation.

articleTitle: Design of Product Quality Process Control System Based on Fuzzy Logic
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: PID controller has been widely used in industrial control systems, and its control ability directly affects the quality of production processes and products. In this paper, fuzzy logic is introduced into the parameter tuning of PID controller, and a product quality process control system based on fuzzy logic is designed. One process refers to a set of interrelated or interacting activities that transform input into output. Finally, the process control system of this design is used to simulate the production process of the brake forceps. The experimental results show that the proposed design scheme can effectively guarantee the quality of the product.

Author Keywords: Product quality, Automatic control system, PID controller, Fuzzy theory, Triangular membership function

articleTitle: Multi-level Estimation and Fuzzy Evaluation of Physical Fitness and Health Effect of College Students in Regular Institutions of Higher Learning Based on Classification and Regression Tree Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In view of the problem that it is impossible to effectively evaluate the multi-level estimation of college students in regular institutions of higher learning with the data theory, a kind of multi-level estimation and fuzzy evaluation of physical fitness and health effect of college students in regular institutions of higher learning based on classification and regression tree algorithm is put forward in this paper. The classification and regression tree algorithm is applied to carry out pretreatment on the physical fitness and health of the college students in the regular institutions of high learning. In accordance with the characteristics of the classification and regression tree algorithm, calculation is performed on the physical fitness and health test data of the college students. The results of the simulation experiments show that this method can make multi-level estimation and fuzzy evaluation of the physical fitness and health of the college students in the regular institutions of high learning both efficiently and reasonably.

Author Keywords: Multi-level Estimation Fuzzy Evaluation of Physical fitness and health Equation
Multi-level Estimation Fuzzy Evaluation of Physical fitness and health Effect
Evaluation on College Students in Regular Institutions of High Learning

articleTitle: An Interdisciplinary Intelligent Teaching System Model Based on College Students' Cognitive Ability
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to improve the cognitive ability of college students and help the teachers understand the students' learning situation clearly, this paper designs an interdisciplinary intelligent teaching model based on domain ontology. Taking the national knowledge infrastructure as the noumenon, according to the students' cognitive ability, it evaluates the domain ontology abstraction layer, and provides the basis for carrying out the teaching plan. Case studies show that this model can help teachers understand students' learning situation clearly and effectively help students achieve the purpose of knowledge cognition.

articleTitle: Configuration Synthesis and Design of a Telescopic Service Robot
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The telescopic service robot is used to transport objects from one place to another and assist the elderly and the disabled in moving and grasping objects. Several configuration are proposed to obtain a long telescopic distance and occupy a small space. This paper mainly deduces and synthesizes the connection methods of the blocks, the drive methods and the shapes of the storage case. Then the optimal configuration of the robot is acquired. A series of blocks driven by the friction wheels are connected in a rigid manner and formed a telescopic arm. The synchronous belt is meshed with the corrugated structures on the upper surface of each block. Besides, the robot has a pitching unit and a slewing unit. The telescopic arm can be pitched and rotated in the vertical and horizontal plane. Hence, this service robot can reach anywhere in a spherical space. The detailed structure of the robot is design and the relevant prototype is developed.

articleTitle: A MAP/M/N Retrial Queueing Model with Asynchronous Single Vacations
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In this paper, we consider an MAP/M/N queue model with asynchronous single vacation which vacation policy is characterized by the different single vacation moments for all servers. We obtain some performance queueing measures of the system by matrix-geometric-solution method. Finally the effects of the parameters of the system are illustrated on the queueing indexes of the system by numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Load Balancing Optimization in Cloud Computing Based on Task Scheduling
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Load imbalance tends to be occurred in cloud computing during to dynamics and complexity. For such problem in the application of cloud computing scheduling, we put forward a Map/Reduce programming model to provide an improved multitask scheduling algorithm which has assigning function on multiple schedules. Then the algorithm process model based on cloud computing platform is constructed, and the load balancing optimization model based on GA is also proposed. The simulations show. The scheme in this paper can satisfy the demand for load balancing under cloud computing and it improves the resource utilization, compared to Min-Min algorithm.

articleTitle: Sports Industry to Promote the Construction of Public Sports Resources Model Based on the Fusion of Nonlinear Bayesian Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to analyze the promoting effect of the sports industry on the construction of public sports resources, a kind of sports industry to promote the construction of public sports resources model based on the fusion of nonlinear Bayesian algorithm is put forward in this paper. Through the application of the nonlinear Bayesian algorithm to the sports industry to promote the construction of public sports resources, the limited public sports resources are allocated to the production of the public sports products and the provision of the services, so as to generate the optimal economic benefits to meet the demand of social groups on sports. Finally, through experiments, the feasibility and effectiveness of the sports industry to the public sports resource model put forward in this paper is verified.

articleTitle: Resource Sharing Strategy of Regional Scientific and Technological Innovation Based on Big Data Analysis Platform
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In the era of big data, the demand for regional innovation is increasingly complicated and the development of scientific and technological resources is developing. Therefore, it is of great practical significance to use evolutionary game theory to study the sharing behavior of scientific and technological resources among regional innovation service platforms. Based on the analysis of the sharing of scientific and technological resources among the regional innovation service platforms, an evolutionary game model is constructed to explore the dynamic evolution process and influence factors of the game equilibrium strategy and the sharing behavior of scientific and technological resources among the platforms. The research shows that the greater complementation of scientific and technological resources between regional innovation service platforms, the higher level of scientific and technological resources in the platform, the stronger the ability of using advanced information technology and the lower cost of sharing the resources of science and technology. Thus, it needs accelerating the promotion of cross platform science and technology and related suggestions are made for the sharing of resources.

articleTitle: Access Control Strategy Based on Trust under Cloud Computing Platform
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: To ensure the availability of system in node interaction under cloud computing, a trust based access control model is proposed in this paper. The model considers the factors including time, weight, QoS and corresponding influence on service nodes. It also utilizes the transitivity of trust to assure that each service of request node can acquire reliable response, which reduce the possibility of none response for resource application. The simulation results indicate the improved access model can raise the objectivity of user trust value and resist all kinds of illegal users to access the cloud computing, which also increase the security and reliability of resources.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Management Decision Support System for Retailing Chains
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Based on system analysis of retailing chains enterprise status, towards objective requirement of enterprise development on decision support system, this paper analyzes and performs entity design in enterprise DSS. We analyze data source, data warehouse structure design, OLAP system structure and front-end display tool, and realize system prototype through historical data. Then, data warehouse technology is used to organize and store chain supermarket supply-chain to manage data warehouse and sets up data warehouse technology OLAP analysis technology-based supply chain performance system and supply-chain management decision support function. The system performs multi-angle analysis in supply-chain, provides management with highly comprehensive information which reflects inventory, retailing and order tendency in order to improve scientific and information degree in decision making.

articleTitle: Design of Remote Network Teaching System for Visual Communication Course
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: With the rapid development of network technology, distance network teaching has become a hot topic in modern teaching reform. This paper designs a remote network teaching system for visual communication courses.The system is developed on the basis of Visual Studio 2008, including five modules:1) Visual design case library module, 2) Online courses module, 3) Design projects and exhibits module, 4) Design practice and communication module, and 5) System management module.in this system, teachers should provide knowledge and resources, and students are able to obtain knowledge and exchange their own ideas.

Author Keywords: Teaching reform, Visual communication design, Remote network teaching, E-R diagram

articleTitle: Research of Automatic Monitoring and Control Strategy of Photovoltaic Power Generation System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: This paper introduces the design and realization of automatic detection and control system in solar photovoltaic power. It adopts ZigBee technology to solve PV module monitoring and mainly studies its communication network. Through ZigBee network and based on multi-hop distribution network, the data acquisition node initially verifies networking scheme. Then, by modeling analysis of the inverter, this paper puts forward double-loop control strategy of grid-connected current. This control strategy ensures inverter output current is stable sine wave in high quality and provides important assurance for photovoltaic grid-connected power. Finally, it is proved that it is effective to eliminate power network voltage on interconnected system dynamic performance and also effective to reduce total harmonic distortion in grid-connected current, through simulation analysis.

articleTitle: An Improved Genetic Algorithm Based on Normal Distribution for Solving the Traveling Salesman Problem
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Traditional genetic algorithm uses ordinary random number as the selection condition of exchange and variation of genetic factors.Inspired by the weed algotithm, the normal distribution sequence is used as a random number library. The location of exchange and variation of genetic factors is read from this library every time and applied to solve the traveling salesman problem.Matlab test shows that this method can improve convergence speed and improve convergence accuracy.

articleTitle: The Control System Design of Coin-Operated Massage Chair
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to improve the quality of life and work efficiency, it has become a new choice for people to use massage chair to relieve fatigue and pressure timely. A coin-operated massage chair control system has been designed in this paper. LPC2131 is adopted as the main controller in the system, which obtains the signals from coin recognition module and control module, after LPC2131 processing, massage chair speed control and the mode are realized by instructions. The system includes a controller module, a lifting module for the back of the massage chair, a control panel module, a music playing module and a display module. Users can realize real-time control of the running state of massage chair through the control panel. After debugging, the software and hardware are fully matched, and the functions of coin recognition, display, music playing, lifting function, running speed and mode control function of the back of massage chair are realized.

articleTitle: Compressive Data Gathering in Wireless Sensor Networks Based on Random Path
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: For the data gathering problem of Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNS), a compressive data gathering based on random path is proposed. The basic idea of the proposed algorithm is to reduce communication cost of data gathering by random path and compressive sensing. Firstly, neighborhood nodes are selected to be effective projection nodes by random path. Then the measurements are obtained by sensing data of these nodes, and they are transmitted to sink by shortest routing strategy. Finally, communication energy consumption of the proposed algorithm is analyzed and sensing data of each node is be reconstructed by measurement matrix. For effective projection nodes are selected by random path, each measurement can be transmitted to sink by only one path. Compared with data gathering methods based on compressive sensing, the proposed methods can remarkably reduce communication energy consumption of data gathering, and can effectively extend the network lifetime. Our experimental results validate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Big Data Equilibrium Scheduling Strategy in Cloud Computing Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In cloud computing environment, big data transmission channel is easily affected by multipath effect, which leads to poor channel equalization, and high bit error rate (BER) of big data transmission. In order to improve the capacity of big data transmission channel equalization scheduling in cloud computing environment, a cloud computing big data equalization scheduling algorithm is proposed based on Porter interval equalization and fuzzy C-means clustering. The big data transport channel model in cloud computing environment is constructed, and the multipath characteristics of big data transmission channel in cloud computing environment are analyzed. The big data output features are analyzed by combining similarity feature extraction and association rule mining method. The auto-correlation beamforming method is used to analyze the information clustering fusion in the big data equalization scheduling process, and the decision feedback equalization scheduling method is used to design the channel equalization of big data output in cloud computing environment. Spread spectrum technology is used to extend the big data transmission channel to improve the equalization of channel scheduling, and the big data clustering processing in cloud computing environment is combined with fuzzy C-means clustering method to realize big data equalization scheduling in cloud computing environment. The simulation results show that big data equalization scheduling in cloud computing environment has better channel equalization, strong anti-jamming ability and improved accuracy of big data classification scheduling.

articleTitle: Multi-sensor Data Fusion Algorithm of Wisdom Agriculture Based on Fusion Set
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In wisdom agriculture, the advanced high-tech equipment is applied and human input is reduced to lower the operation and management costs and enhance agricultural management efficiency. In this thesis, a multi-sensor data fusion algorithm based on fusion set is put forward, the fusion algorithm model is defined and the effectiveness of this fusion algorithm is testified through experimental comparison, which enhances data collection reliability and robustness of wisdom agriculture system.

articleTitle: Design of Digital Cell Plane Based on 3DMAX
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Using 3DS MAX 3D technology, through the simulation of residential buildings, roads, green space, public facilities and other models, the virtual environment of community facilities and environment is reproduced. With the concept and theory of "digital city" being proposed, creating digital 3D urban scenes has become a hot topic of research. The simulation technology based on virtual reality has increasingly become a hot spot of research. The introduction of virtual reality technology into the design and research of "digital residential community" provides a new means for the planning and design of residential quarters. This paper introduces the acquisition of the plot map of the community, the creation of the two-dimensional plane graphic of the community, the collection of the data of the community and the construction of the three-dimensional model of the community. It focuses on the key technologies of the creation of the three-dimensional model in the 3D environment and the setting of the material and light.

articleTitle: Research on Storage Mechanism of Cloud Security Policy
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Cloud computing, cloud security and cloud storage have been gradually introduced into people's life and become hot topicsof research, for which relevant technologies have permeated through the computer industry and relevant industries. With the coming of the modern information society, secure storage of data has been becoming increasingly important. Proceeding from traditional policy storage, this paper includes comparison and improvement of policy storage for the purpose of meeting requirements of storage of cloud security policy. Policy storage technology refers to a technology used to realize storage of policies created by users and relevant policy information. Policy repository can conduct centralized management and processing of multiple policies and their relevant information. At present, popular policy repositories generally include policy storage for relational database or policy storage for directory server or a file in a fixed format, such as XML file format.

articleTitle: User Security Authentication Scheme under SaaS Platform of Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: To solute the problem in corporate champion-centered multi-tenant business correlation characteristics of industry chain collaborative platform and integrating with data storage of combination between enterprise alliance-oriented independent database, shared database and shared table, this paper analyzes industrial chain coordinating SaaS platform of security encryption configuration requirement of multi-tenant business data which takes corporate champion as the core. It puts forward business data encryption configuration algorithm of corporate champion, encryption configuration data-driven business data encryption and submission algorithm of collaborative enterprises, and corporate champion-oriented business data query decryption algorithm. Finally, the platform data is used to verification, authorization configuration management, key configuration management and hierarchical decryption query of user's identity authentication. The results show that corporate champion configuration can realize personalized data encryption requirement of different alliances.

articleTitle: Selection Model of Optimal Mixed Teaching Mode in Higher Vocational Colleges Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Under the background of big data, we should select the best hybrid teaching mode in higher vocational colleges, improve the ability of big data analysis of the mixed teaching mode in higher vocational colleges, and improve the quality of hybrid teaching mode in higher vocational colleges. A model for selecting hybrid teaching mode in the optimal higher vocational colleges is proposed based on big data. The big data analysis model of hybrid teaching in the optimal higher vocational colleges is constructed, and the information fusion of the mixed teaching mode in the optimal higher vocational colleges is carried out by using the structured big data information recombination method. The characteristic quantity of the associated information describing the optimal hybrid teaching mode in higher vocational colleges is extracted, and the big data fusion scheduling and optimization selection of the mixed teaching mode based on the piecewise information fusion is adopted. According to the characteristic clustering results, the self-regression analysis of the evaluation ability of hybrid teaching in the optimal higher vocational colleges is carried out, and the test statistic model is constructed to optimize the selection of the hybrid teaching model in higher vocational colleges. The simulation results show that this method is used to select the mixed teaching mode in higher vocational colleges, the information fusion ability of outputting big data is better, and the accuracy of model selection is high.

articleTitle: Intelligent Selection System Design for Tea Culture Tourist Path
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: This article starts from many aspects to study the optimal design of tourist route of Pu'er city surrounding scenic spot. According to the principles of tea culture tourism route design and the demand characteristics of tourists, a tourism route based on improved intelligent system optimization is established. Through the route optimization of special tourist attractions we design the route for tourists to visit as many scenic spots as possible, regarding as limited time cost. The user experience index in also introduced as the optimality parameters to verify the feasibility of line. Based on above results, three 3 distinctive tourist routes are designed to provide the best user experience for tourists.

articleTitle: Suspension System Design of All-Terrain Fire-Fighting Robot
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In this paper, a single longitudinal arm suspension structure for fire-fighting robot is proposed, which has good adaptability to the ground. The structure of the suspension is introduced in detail, and the strength calculation of the suspension structure is carried out for the application of the fire-fighting robot, and the ground performance of the robot is verified by the experiment.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Intelligent Building Engineering Information Management System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Through the analysis of main business process and management model in building engineering, this paper combines with characteristics of intelligent building engineering and status quo of information technology development to analyze program organization model of industrial typical enterprises. By means of request analysis in information system of intelligent building enterprises, main frameworks in system are determined and main business process in system is deeply analyzed to offer main use-case model and its description. Then, objective technology is used to offer main design principle in system, system structure design, main functional modules and interface design to complete design in system database. Based on system test results, the business management system of intelligent building engineering which is designed and developed in this paper can satisfy bidding and user requirement in building process management, realize project-centered various participants' collaborative management and remote control management visualization, and provide dynamic information management for building projects.

articleTitle: Interference Rejection Power Control Scheme for Underwater Acoustic Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In Underwater Acoustic Sensor Networks (UASNs), the interference is serious due to the harsh underwater environment. To address this issue, a new power control scheme, interference rejection power control scheme, is proposed by this paper for the hierarchical structure in UASNs. By applying the property of hierarchical network structure, the closed form expression of outage probability is derived. Finally, some numerical simulation for the outage probability is supplied in this paper. Through numerical simulation analysis, it is concluded that interference rejection power control scheme proposed by this paper can effectively decrease the network outage probability.

Author Keywords: UASN, Hierarchical structure, SINR, Interference rejection power control, Outage probability

articleTitle: Optimization Design of Network Structure Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to improve the ability of network optimization, a network optimization architecture design method based on genetic algorithm is proposed to construct the optimal network structure model of wireless sensor networks. The adaptive fusion method is used to process the fusion tracking filter of the network sensor nodes, and the extended Kalman filter algorithm is used to detect the correlation of the output nodes in the network structure. Combining the channel expansion and adaptive frequency domain equalization method, the equalization control of network transmission channel is carried out, and the genetic algorithm is used for adaptive optimization to realize the equalization of the network output channel. The hybrid channel estimation method is used to optimize the network structure to improve the channel equalization control and error compensation ability of the network. The simulation results show that the proposed method has good channel equalization and adaptive networking ability, and the stability of the network output is improved.

articleTitle: Dynamic Migration Optimization Algorithm for Virtual Machine under Trusted Computing Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: For the load balancing of the whole cloud computing architecture, we need to use the virtual machine's dynamic online migration technology. Based on TCCP model, this article improves the trusted third-party coordinator, and migrates partial management of TC to node TN to prevent the TC leakage which may cause the security of the whole model to be destroyed. At the same time, to ensure the integrity of the online migration, the trusted computing module provides a complete trust measure, stores the measurement value, and constructs a complete trusted chain, providing a platform to guarantee the remote verification of the migration. Finally, through the integrity measurement and verification function provided by TPM, measurement and validation are performed before the virtual machine starts migration, to ensure the integrity of the migration.

articleTitle: Fast Retrieving Approach for 3D Models Based on Semantic Tree
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: To solute the problem in 3D model retrieval based on text and content, the application of semantic tree is put forward. The method constructs 3D model semantic tree based on WordNet, under PSB(Princeton Shape Benchmark) ontology library, to proposes a novel approach of constructing semantic tree. It can simplify the process of expansion of semantic tree and adopts amount of information to compute the model which has higher returning similarity. It provides a retrieving method and can optimize the retrieval results according to the feedback mechanism based on shape feature, simultaneously. The experiments show our approach can improve the efficiency of 3D model retrieving effectively.

articleTitle: Study on Coordinated Control Strategy of Source and Load Based on Enhancing Wind Power Consumption
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: With the rapid development of wind power, the randomness and intermittent nature of its output have led to an increase in the regulation pressure of conventional power supplies. The traditional dispatching and operating modes have been unable to meet the demand for large-scale wind power transmission. In this paper, the high energy load with adjustable characteristics is taken as an important means to consume wind power, and a mathematical model for response control of high energy load is established. On this basis, the load-coordinating control power optimization model of the Japanese time scale is studied, and the Japanese-level time-scale source coordination control strategy based on increasing the power consumption of wind power is formed in combination with the Japanese source-time coordinated control mode of the load source. The simulation of Hexi Power Grid in Gansu province is given as an example to verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed coordinated control strategy based on improving wind power consumption.

articleTitle: An Optimized K-Means Algorithm Based on FSTVM
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Aiming at the text document similarity and initial center point problems of K-means algorithm, a new model is proposed, in which used a new method of Frequency-Sorted Term Vector Model(FSTVM) to represent a document, and for reducing the dimension of a document designed an automatic method to filter commonly used words, and redesigned the similarity calculation formula and optimization algorithm for the initial center. Compared with the traditional algorithms, the new proposed algorithm can get initial centers with higher quality and steadier cluster results, Experimental results prove this clustering algorithm is simple and effective.

Author Keywords: K-Means Algorithm, Frequency-Sorted Term Vector Model, Document Similarity, Initial Center Point

articleTitle: Impacts on High Frequency Communications Based on OPNET
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: This paper mainly studies the effect of different parameters on high frequency communications, so as to make use of high frequency communications more effectively. Specifically, through the constructions of network, node and process models based on OPNET, and averaging on numerous realizations, we acquire the impacts of the number and traffic load of the wireless nodes on the delay, the throughput and the packet loss rate of HF communications. And then, simulation results are provided to analyze the validation of the results.

articleTitle: Face Feature Dynamic Recognition Method Based on Intelligent Image
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to improve the performance of dynamic face recognition, a face recognition technology based on intelligent image is proposed, the signature features of the face are extracted, the information is sampled with the feature information of the pupil, eyelid, facial features and facial expression of a face. The face image is segmented by adaptive template matching method, and the feature information of pupil and eyelid is extracted by three-dimensional dynamic scanning method. The best pixel feature of the target face image is obtained by using the matched filter detector, and the dynamic 3D feature information of the face is extracted, and the face dynamic recognition is carried out according to the feature extraction result. The simulation results show that the proposed method is more accurate. It can improve the accuracy and resolution of face recognition.

articleTitle: Cultural Tourism Products Design Optimization Based on User Satisfaction
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Starting with the design of cultural landscape tourism experience, this article studies the principle of tourism product design with QFD method, for the defects in traditional measures. It introduces the concepts such as expected service quality and actual perceived service quality, and proposes a multi-objective tourism product optimization design model with maximum tourist satisfaction and minimum design cost, by the analysis of tourism service elements and alternatives for implementation elements, and consideration of the relationship between the alternatives and the tourism elements. Finally, through an actual case of optimal design of tourism products for parent-child tourism, we analyze the choice of solution for the target model under different weights and verify the feasibility and effectiveness of our approach.

articleTitle: The Application of Decision Tree in the Prediction of Winning Team
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Decision tree algorithm is mainly used for analyzing data and forecasting.The algorithm is easy to understand and implement, and it is easy to evaluate the model through static testing.In this paper, the decision tree algorithm is applied to predict the result of Chinese Football Association Super League(CFASL). In this paper, the data of CFASL 2015, 2016 and 2017 seasons are collected. And "the result of each team's last match", "compare of teams' ranking in last season", "the result of last time the two teams played",etc. are selected as features to predict the winner of a CFASL match. The experiments found that "two teams' performance in their recent matches", "whether team A has defeated team B as an away team" and "whether team B has defeated team A as an away team" played a key role in improving the accuracy of predicting.

articleTitle: Internet Newborn Word Recognition Method under Conditional Random Field Model
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: This paper proposes an approach of automatic detection of new words. It analyzes the webpages acquired from Internet on a large scale and detect new words. According to morphological rules it will perform further filtering on detection results to extract existed new words in the corpus. Our scheme adopts conditional random field and puts forward twp improvement: in the new word detection stage, a high efficient left (right) entropy calculation method is proposed to improve the detection speed, which effectively reduces the influence of unrelated characters in the calculation; then, a quantized model of missing logged words is also proposed, which is based on participle to extract repeated strings, and it can be used to evaluate the problem of missing words. The CRF based combination model proposed in this paper is proved to be a very effective new word detection method, whether from the open experiment effect or the generalization ability of the model.

articleTitle: Development and Application of College Innovation and Entrepreneurship Cloud Platform Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The university innovation and entrepreneurship cloud platform has customized construction value and advantage for every entrepreneur. The innovative entrepreneurial cloud platform based on big data is designed in this paper, which mainly revolves around innovation and entrepreneurship. It provides strong technical support in entrepreneurial project management, expert tutor library construction, competition registration and net review, double venture, team formation and cloud resource application. Through cloud computing, integrated technologies including B/S architecture, JSP are adopted to achieve the functions of data mining, dynamic deployment, resource sharing, personnel collaboration and other functions of the management business process. It also provides a large-scale and open information platform for university students in innovation and entrepreneurship.

articleTitle: Grain Analysis Method and Model Research of High and Big One-Storey Granaries in North Cold Regions
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: High and big one-storey granaries are the large-scale grain storage facilities generally adopted in our country. Mass data are obtained through the grain monitoring system equipped for a great number of high and big one-storey granaries, but they are only explored and utilized by resorting to the working experience of management personnel, without any scientific instruction on the operating management of granaries. With No. 49 silo of Qinjia Granary as the example, and through the data classification methods of four-layer one-shell and seven-core one shell, the paper analyzes grain data of high and big one-storey granaries in northeast cold regions of our country, and establishes the time series prediction model. The findings indicate that the two data classification methods can efficiently simplify the analysis process, and display spatial-temporal variation rules of grain; the relevancy between grain temperature data and ambient temperature data of high and big one-storey granaries is weakened gradually from top layer, middle layer, and lower layer to bottom layer. In reality, grain risk degree can be judged according to grain data of the middle layer, such as range, change rate, etc. Grain temperature data of high and big one-storey granaries conform to the sinusoidal variation model in terms of layer and core, and there are the differences in range and phase angle.

articleTitle: Application of Configuration Software in Remote Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to monitor the physical quantities, environmental parameters and process data in industrial production process in real time. A remote monitoring system based on configuration software is designed in this paper. The system has many advantages such as open interface, flexible use, real-time tasks and reliable operation. Database system is a key part of configuration software, including real-time database and general database, which is of great significance to the realization of remote monitoring system.

Author Keywords: Remote monitoring system, Configuration software, Configuration system, Real-time system, Real-time database

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Oil Painting Online Appreciation System Based on Android
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: This paper takes online display of oil paintings as the main research objective. It studies design and application of oil painting online display system and constructs a set of mobile platform-based oil painting appreciation system to be adapted to response-front layout of mobile terminal device. We apply MVC framework of PHP in WebApp development. Front-end adopts the currently latest HTMLS technology and Bootstrap framework so that system has effective compatibility and platform crossing to provide unified experience for useless devices. The system establishes role authority control-based system and associates content to corresponding roles through detailed role distribution of content so the development of system business logic is more standardized. Finally, various functions and performance indexes in oil painting online display system are tested and the feasibility of this improved scheme is proved.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Security Robot for Public Safety
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: This paper designs a security robot for public safety. The robot can be temporarily placed in a crowded place, monitoring the flow of people and assisting the public security officers to conduct effective evacuation and warning. In this paper, the structure and hardware system of the robot are introduced in detail. In view of the use scenario, the strength check and function test of wind resistant overturning stability are carried out. The robot's application can effectively improve the security work efficiency and reduce the police burden.

articleTitle: Study on Ferroresonance Over-Voltage Based on Harmonic Elimination Device
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The paper calculated the accident of the voltage transformer caused by the ferromagnetic resonance over-voltage in Hunan power grid, and analyzed the generation principle of the ferromagnetic resonance over-voltage. The simulation model of 10kV distribution line was established through ATP, and the ferromagnetic resonance over-voltage caused by single-phase ground and two-phase in the system was simulated and analyzed. Aiming at the generation principle of ferromagnetic resonance over-voltage, The paper proposed the measures of harmonic resonance elimination of the voltage Transformer, and analyzed the protection effect through simulation model. The research showed that the measure of neutral earthing via suppression coil is most effective for eliminating ferromagnetic resonance.For the second side loading harmonic resistance, the smaller the resistance, the more obvious of elimination effect, but the resistance is too small can cause TV overload, need to pay attention to the capacity of the TV.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of An Intelligent System for Building Virtual Roaming
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: As is well known that virtual building roaming is an effective solution which can effectively integrate the digital virtual roaming and the building structure animation together. In this paper, we study on the intelligent system for building virtual roaming which can spread the architecture culture widely. Firstly, the intelligent system is divided into three parts: automatic roaming, role roaming, and control module. In the whole process of building body modeling, we import CAD drawings into ADS Max, to exploit the drawings as the background map of the whole view window. Then we draw the outline of the building by line drawing. Next, we import all synthetic models into the virtual software through the visual tractor operation. Finally, the performance testing demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed system, and we can find that the intelligent system can significantly help the architecture culture to be spread widely.

Author Keywords: Virtual roaming, Architecture culture, Role roaming, Control module, Requirement analysis

articleTitle: Mining Analysis for College Students' Physical Performance and Fitness Tests
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: According to actual demand for system analysis, this paper designs and develops data mining analysis system of college students' physical performance and physical ability test data, Based on data mining technology in physical performance management and physical ability analysis application. The system takes test data of college athletes' physical ability as analysis object. It applies data mining technology and solves physical ability index optimization of athletes' physical ability. We introduce principle and method of association rule mining, propose and realize the algorithms which are appropriate for college students' physical index operation analysis. Then, this method will be applied to construct rule tree with specific cases, and to evaluate athletes' physical ability status, obtaining related and valuable physical teaching reference. Finally, through example test and analysis, the system is verified to be accuracy in related functions and it has practical application value to use data mining-based method to solve these problems.

articleTitle: Experimental Research of Corncob Rectangle Granaries in the Northeast Region
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The northeast region is the main producing area of corn in China, which is chiefly planted, harvested, and stored by farmers. Before processed and sold, corn has to be dewatered for storage. Corncob storage is the primary form of corn storage, supplemented by grain storage. The big porosity of corncob storage is favorable for natural ventilation and dewatering. At present, there is a variety of granary types promoted and used in our country, and such granaries are designed and fabricated in the light of experience of the predecessors, lacking theoretical discussion and experimental research. Through experiments, the paper studies the in-store drying of rectangle granaries of different ventilation widths, and establishes the grain monitoring software/hardware system. Under the natural ventilation conditions, the paper conducts the analysis and study of moisture and ingredient quality changes of corncobs during the in-store drying period and after the drying, and presents some valuable references for in-store drying of corncobs stored in rectangle granaries and the reasonable optimization of granary structure.

articleTitle: Study on the Dispatching of Wind-Energy Complementary Combined Power Generation Grid
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: With the depletion of traditional fossil energy sources, renewable energy resources, such as wind power and photovoltaic, have developed rapidly, and the installed capacity of the world has continued to grow. But subject to the power grid transmission capacity and load capacity limits, in fact grid given the ability of renewable energy is relatively limited, a renewable energy "can't surf the Internet", caused a great deal of energy waste. Therefore, it is necessary to conduct in-depth research on how to improve the consumption capacity of multiple renewable energy sources. Based on the above background, this paper takes the reconfiguration of distribution network as the starting point to explore the feasibility of improving the consumption capacity of multiple renewable energy sources.

articleTitle: Improvement of Efficient Scheduling Algorithm for Network Massive Resources
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In the embedded network design and application, we need to optimize the network resources scheduling design, improve the network process management and memory management efficiency, a network mass resource scheduling algorithm based on double threshold load balancing control is proposed. The model of network mass resource information flow is constructed, and the time scale feature of network mass resource information flow is extracted, and the time axis of network mass resource scheduling is divided into evenly distributed time windows. By using linear coding control method, network mass resource scheduling is implemented simultaneously to realize clustering equilibrium, which improves the anti-interference ability of network mass resource scheduling, and the improved design of network mass resource scheduling algorithm is realized. The simulation results show that the equalization control ability and throughput of mass network resource scheduling using this method are good.

articleTitle: The Development of Multiple Intelligent Grid Music
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In the context of the theory of multiple intelligences, this article focuses on the relationship between music intelligence and other intelligences such as power grids and electrical appliances, discusses the role of music education in smart overall development, and briefly analyzes how music education integrates with other subject teaching and cooperative teaching of interdisciplinary.

articleTitle: Analysis & Design of Fiber Bragg Grating Passive Temperature Measurement Data Acquisition System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Data acquisition management system is constantly developing and finding wide applications. A user-friendly Fiber Bragg Grating passive temperature measurement data acquisition management system is designed to offer the relatively more comfortable and convenient experience to users. The system is developed on the platform of Microsoft Visual Studio 2010 with abundant instruction control statements, necessary classes and objects, and varied data types. All of these features ensure the excellent performance of the system, make it meet the need of code modularization, and conduce to the expansion, deletion, and modification of the system. The system helps complete the design of human-computer interaction interfaces of multipoint Fiber Bragg Grating, including wave length display interface, corresponding temperature display and control interface, and data acquisition, storage, and playback analysis control interface. Through the system, users can experience the excellent and efficient performance of Fiber Bragg Grating passive temperature data acquisition management.

articleTitle: Design of Performance Evaluation Model for Accurate Poverty Alleviation Projects Based on Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of the performance evaluation of the precision poverty alleviation project, a performance evaluation model based on a large data analysis for the accurate poverty alleviation project is proposed. The regression test of the large data of the performance evaluation of the accurate poverty alleviation project is carried out with the descriptive statistical average analysis results, and the fuzzy C mean fusion is used. The clustering method is used to classify the performance of the precision poverty alleviation project. According to the results of the data clustering, the effectiveness of the investment of the poor capital is evaluated, the quantitative evaluation model of the performance of the financial expenditure and the poverty alleviation project is set up, the financial structure is adjusted by the F statistics analysis method, and the electric business is carried out according to the statistical analysis results of the poverty alleviation. The self-adaptive adjustment of the precision poverty alleviation project and the large data analysis method are used to optimize the performance evaluation and optimization of the accurate poverty alleviation project. The results of the empirical analysis show that the accuracy of the performance evaluation of the accurate poverty alleviation project is high, the large data processing efficiency is high, and the fusion is better.

articleTitle: Optimization of Intelligent Neural Network Prediction Based on Particle Swarm
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In view of the disadvantages of slow convergence and local optimality in traditional neural network learning algorithms, a neural network nonlinear function fitting system with improved particle swarm optimization (PSO) is designed for intelligent prediction accuracy. The intelligent optimization scheme integrates the immune PSO algorithm with BP neural network theory, and realizes the nonlinear function fitting algorithm of BP neural network, based on IPSO algorithm optimization. The new fitting algorithm first determines the structure of the BP neural network, and optimizes the initial weight and threshold with IPSO algorithm. Then, it improves the intelligent prediction method to verify the performance. Numerical experiments show that the algorithm proposed in this paper improves the fitting ability of BP neural network, reduces the fitting error and improves the fitting accuracy.

articleTitle: Teaching Quality Evaluation Scheme for Vocational College Based on Students' Satisfaction
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Current assessment model in vocational education quality does not display vocational education as educational service product. It does not fully consider customers' satisfaction factor whose representative is work unit and students so it has disadvantages. Based on foreign and domestic researches of customers' satisfaction-degree, with characteristics of nationally vocational colleges, this paper discusses and sets up testing model in customers' satisfaction-degree of vocational college and operates empirical analysis through designing and performing questionnaires. Students' focusing importance and satisfaction of various indexes in universities are performed empirical research from customer value perspectives.
