It discovers key factors to affect customer's satisfaction in vocational college and puts forwards countermeasures for vocational colleges to improve customer's satisfaction.

articleTitle: A SVPWM Compensation Current Tracking Control Method Based on dq Transformation for Shunt Active Power Filter
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The working principle of the shunt active power filter, the main circuit structure and the instruction current operation circuit including the DC side voltage control link are introduced. A SVPWM compensation current tracking control method based on dq transformation is proposed, and the simulation model is built by using the PSIM9.0. It is proved by PSIM simulation that the method has simple control and can accurately track the change of reference current, effectively reduce the switching frequency of PWM converter, and verify the superiority of the method.

articleTitle: Driving Solution for All-Terrain Firefighting Robot
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The power and transmission systems of the firefighting robot are directly related to the overall movement performance of the robot. This paper makes a comparative analysis of various types of dynamical systems for existing firefighting robots. It expounds on a new type of pure electrical drive power form, and it verifies the effectiveness of text pure electric drive plus multi-stage deceleration method, which is tested in a variety of road conditions.

articleTitle: Research on the Quality Evaluation System of Modern Packaging Design
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Packaging industry is an important way to promote the development of national economy. The quality of packaging design directly affects the sales volume of products. In this paper, the quality evaluation system of packaging design is studied, and a quality evaluation method of packaging design based on Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) is proposed. Compared with the basic analytic hierarchy process, the experimental results show that the evaluation method proposed in this paper can better evaluate the quality of packaging design.

Author Keywords: Package design quality, Fuzzy analytic hierarchy process, Triangular fuzzy numbers, Pairwise comparison matrix

articleTitle: Appliance of Apriori Algorithm on Technical-Tactics Analysis of Volleyball
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In any sport has become increasingly inseparable from the accurate sports information. Volleyball is a complicated collective project, how to fast and efficient access to accurate information to become the teams stadium outside the main competition competition. By using the method of documentation research, expert interviews and mathematical statistics, the paper presents a data model for analysis volleyball technical and tactical, and applys a data mining algorithm named Apriori in the field with a little change, for the volleyball scene and after the video statistics provides a new train of thought.

articleTitle: Relative Fatigue Life Analysis for Bearing of the Robot of Feeding System In Naval Gun's Ammunition
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Two-dimensional digital filtering method is used to simulate the machining surface of the thin walled rotary table bearing of the robot of feeding system in naval gun's ammunition. Taking individual contact pair as the research object, the surface stress distribution is solved by multigrid method under the condition of elastohydrodynamic lubrication. The subsurface stress is solved by ANSYS. Based on the stress life model of Zaresky, the effects of the rough surface parameters, such as RMS(root mean square root), skewness, and kurtosis on relative fatigue life of the thin walled rotary table bearing are studied. The relationships between the RMS, skewness, kurtosis and the relative fatigue life of the bearing are obtained.

articleTitle: A Novel Vehicle Tracking Algorithm Using Video Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Due to convenient installation, large coverage area and be effective, video detection technology has become a research focus in current traffic incident detection field. This paper simply introduces common tracking algorithm and its principle of several moving objects and puts forward a Kalman filter-based feature matching tracking method. First, we apply temporal difference method to detect moving objects and obtain their initial position. Then, this paper adopts Kalman filter to predict the moving objects position at next period and utilizes results of moving objects detection to evaluate and correct predicting results. This obtains correct position of moving objects and analyzes vehicles movement according to tracking results. The experiment results show this method can effectively solve reliable tracking under condition of partial occlusion and short-time total occlusion of moving targets.

articleTitle: Outpatient Medicine Query System Based on .NET
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The outpatient medicine query system makes the manual medicine management change to paperless and information-based, that is to accelerate the operation of the pharmaceutical department and achieve the level of conservation and environmental protection. This system designs a .NET based outpatient medicine query system to realize the paperless management of information management instead of manual management, so as to improve the efficiency and quality of the outpatient medicine query in the process of out-patient medicine inquiry, which makes the outpatient medicine query from two aspects: transparent and easy to operate.

articleTitle: The Constructing of Intelligent Decision Supporting System for the Obese Individuals Exercise Prescription
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Under the conditions of today's society, more and more people begin to pay attention to their health problems, Obesity is a growing problem. Using the computer program to simulate the decision-making process of health experts, it wants to provide the comprehensive and quantitative health promotion services to the obese individuals, and help them to lose weight scientifically. The paper combines the technical features of multi-agent to form the intelligent decision supporting system for exercise prescription of obese individuals based on multi-agent. And studies for the system decision-making process and system implementation are also presented.

articleTitle: Intelligent Comprehensive Assessment of Employability of Art Design Students Relying on Nonlinear Regression Algorithm (NRA)
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The employment rate has always been the focus of people's attention. With the year-by-year expansion of the art design profession, the problem of student employment has become an urgent problem for all colleges and universities. This article presents an intelligent comprehensive assessment of employability of art design students. This method utilizes the environmental perception and autonomous behavior decision-making ability of the nonlinear regression algorithm (NRA), achieves an intelligent comprehensive assessment of the employability of art design students, and finally through the experimental analysis shows that the proposed method can be used as the new thought of the teaching reform of art design students in colleges and universities under the ever-changing social development, in an employment-oriented way cultivate students' professional skills, and improve the evaluation system of students' employability.

articleTitle: Art Design Scheme of Modern Urban Commercial Public Space Using Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: This article takes the urban public environment facilities as the research object, and cites the related subject theory as well as the mature research methods at home and abroad, to explore the specific characteristics of the commercial public space. We sum up the main points of the space, and complete the basic understanding of the research on the optimization of the status of commercial public space, which lays the foundation for the human and machine intelligent interactive system to permeate the base. According to related theories, the application of man-machine interaction system under the commercial public space is defined, and the changes of the man-machine system to its commercial public are defined from various levels. Then, a commercial public space environment is designed as the blueprint to discuss the commercial public space under the man-machine interaction system. The scheme achieves the interaction between human and space, optimizes the function of the whole commercial public space and improves the art of space environment.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Three Dimensional Virtual Roaming System for Modern Park
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: For the practical requirement of digital park design, this paper comprehensively explores technological difficulties of three dimensional modern park in detail. In the process of specific analysis and research, it mainly further optimizes and improves related models to introduce multi-detailed hierarchy technology to models. During system development, scripting module which is offered by Virtools designs and realizes virtual roaming modes of automatic roaming and manual roaming. Meanwhile, it elaborates some key technologies to realize animation and roaming in VRP. Test analysis shows that virtual park in this paper is perfect in reality sense and scene demonstration is fast so it is convenient for users and scenes to interactively operate in order to assist further 3D parks construction in cities.

articleTitle: A Traceable Control Synchronous Lifting System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: This production involves a position and speed control system consisting of two electric cylinders. IAI finished wire rod electric cylinder is selected for the electric cylinder, and the driver is selected with its matching pulse stepping type driver. C8051F340 single-chip microcontroller is adopted as the controller. During the cylinder movement, the single-chip microcomputer reads the output of the encoder through the serial port to calculate the position and speed, and completes its own motion control according to the task requirements. An infrared transmitter and three receiving tubes constitute a position detection and tracking system. The tracking side microcontroller collects the voltage on the photoelectric receiving tube through AD, calculates and measures the exact position and motion direction of the tracked side in real time, and completes the tracking control according to the task requirements. The system function is stable and can be used for reference in many fields such as industrial control and intelligent control.

articleTitle: Mongolian-Chinese Cross-Language Query Expansion Based on Cross-Language Word Vectors
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Cross-Language information retrieval is supposed to make information retrieval of one language according to the queries of other languages, and it is a important branch of information retrieval. Recently, cross-language word vectors performs effectively on cross-language information retrieval, and more and more researchers get interested in this field. This paper takes use of cross-language word vectors to map Chinese query words to Mongolian query words, which will be used to perform information retrieval. Three methods were proposed in this paper to perform mapping, namely Series, Series_opt and Cross_valid. These methods are used to map the Chinses queries as well as to select and sort the mapped words. Experimental results conducted in the real environments show that our proposed algorithm can obtain improvement on Mongolian-Chinses cross-language information retrieval.

articleTitle: An Efficient University Administration Management Information Model Design
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: How to design and implement an effective university administration management information system is of great importance for modern university management. Therefore, in this paper, we proposed a novel and efficient university administration management information model. To design an effective information system, we utilize the B/S mode to develop the proposed system. In particular, B/S structure refers to a type of three layers of distributed system, which includes Web Server, database Server, and application Server. Next, the proposed system is able to be used for the administrative departments at all levels to use the requirement and realize the office network and information network. Experimental results show that the proposed university administration management information is easy to use, and can achieve both lower CPU and memory utilization rate.

Author Keywords: university administration, management information model, B/S structure, XML

articleTitle: Design of Psychological Data Management System for University Students Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: As a successor to national construction, university students are of great significance for their psychological management and data mining. This paper first discusses the feasibility of data mining technology on College Students' psychological management, and then uses Visual Studio 2008, ASP.NET and C# to develop a mental data management system for college students based on data mining. The experimental results show that the system can effectively excavate the psychological data of college students, and provide a new way of thinking for university students' mental health education.

articleTitle: Development and Application of An Intelligent Learning System for Interactive College English
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: For the feature of Android system, an intelligent learning system for college English interaction is designed in this paper. According to the designing rules of study interface, design principles and learning function design of learning interaction, corresponding rules are set first. Then, the overall intelligent system structure are analyzed and sub-modules of system are designed, which is packaged each. The database of system is also designed and detailed realization scheme is provided. During the process of application, the function module is realized respectively and all the modules get organic combination by module calling. The performance tests of intelligent learning system indicate that it can satisfy the demand of users and it improves the study efficiency for graduates in interactive English learning

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on the Competency Model of College Counselors
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: As the backbone of the ideological and political work in Colleges and universities, the ability of counselors directly affects the training of talents in Colleges and universities. In order to improve the competency of college counselors, this paper first conducted a questionnaire survey and interviews, and designed a competency model for university counselors. The empirical research results show that this model can fully present the competency of university counselors and promote the training and construction of university counselors.

articleTitle: Research on Stability of Active Oil Supply Radial Dynamic Pressure Bearings
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Under the influence of internal structure and external factors, the radial dynamic bearing is prone to instability during high speed operation, which leads to low processing precision or waste products. The paper studies the feasibility of the internal pressurization mode to change the stability of dynamic pressure bearing. The pressure control equation of active control dynamic pressure bearing is established, the dynamic characteristics of hydrodynamic bearing under different eccentricity are calculated, and the results show that the active pressure bearing can not only reduce the cross stiffness but also not damage the direct damping, At the same time can effectively improve the stability of dynamic pressure bearing.

articleTitle: A Multi-path Transmission Method for Wireless Sensor Network Based on Network Coding
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: How to ensure high quality multi-path transmission is of great importance for wireless sensor network, hence, in this paper, we propose a novel multi-path transmission method based on network coding. Wireless sensor networks are made up of three types nodes, among which the base station records the data of each cluster from the gateways, and the sensor can collect data from external environment. Afterwards, wireless sensors receive information from the gateway, and send it to neighbor nodes. Afterwards, we propose a novel multi-path transmission model for wireless sensor network, which is represented as a directed hypergraph. To solve the issue of packet loss which is obtained by the high bit error rate, the actual number of packets transmitted by the source node is obtained. Then, we calculate the times of network coding, and the group numbers is randomly selected by the source code from the sensing area. Finally, the proposed algorithm can achieve lower transmission cost, energy consumption and time cost than other methods.

Author Keywords: multi-path transmission, wireless sensor network, network coding, graph model

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of Three Dimensional Flow Field in Water Treatment Agitator Based on Fluent
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Because of the complex flow phenomenon in the mixing equipment, the design of the mixing equipment depends on the actual operation experience of the engineers. With the increasing application of numerical simulation technology in various fields, the application of numerical simulation technology to the design of mixing equipment has a great advantage over the traditional experience design method. In this paper, the three-dimensional flow field of the water treatment agitator is simulated by two modeling methods, and the characteristics of the flow field are compared and analyzed, which will provide some reference for the optimization design of the water treatment process.

articleTitle: An Oral English Training Method Based on Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Oral English training is a crucial part in English teaching. How to fully exploit information technology and big data technology to promote the quality of oral English training has attracted more and more attention. In this paper, we aim to propose a novel oral English training method based on big data analysis. In particular, there are two main considerations in this paper, that is, 1) what information services and support for a specific user and which page content is arranged, and 2) the identity worker with the unique identity of different ID. Afterwards, we discuss how to utilize the hidden Markov model to achieve speech recognition, which is a key module in this proposed system. Finally, experimental results prove that the proposed solution can obtain high accuracy of speech recognition, and then enhance users' scores on English course.

Author Keywords: oral English training, speech recognition, big data, hidden Markov model

articleTitle: Evaluation Method of Nano-Carbon Fiber Grounding Grid Considering Short Circuit Current Distribution
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Aiming at the difference of electrical specification and heat stability between nonmetal and metal grounding materials, an appraisal procedure is proposed for the performance of nano-carbon fiber grounding grid. A detailed evaluation process is presented for the security evaluation of nano-carbon fiber grounding grid, considering to equivalent sectional area of conductor, short-circuit current and its influence to calculate for Grounding parameters, rise and distribution of grounding potential and so on.The diffuser performance of nano-carbon fiber and common metal grounding grid is analyzed by contact potential, step potential difference and grounding potential rise. The results show that nano-carbon fiber can be applied to grounding grid of tower. The method in this paper is referred to assess the safety of nonmetal grounding materials.

articleTitle: Identification Model of Commodity False Reviews Based on Integrated Features
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: More and more consumers like online shopping, and false reviews of goods mislead consumers to some extent, so it is necessary to design a false review detection method. Based on the integration characteristics of consumer history reviews, this paper proposes an online false comment detection model. The model introduces time series and combines the static and dynamic features of the reviews to detect false comments. Finally, the model is used to test the comment data of three kinds of Amazon products. The results show that the model has high recognition accuracy.

articleTitle: Analysis on Dynamic Monitoring of Land Use in Chenggong District of Kunming
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Remote sensing has irreplaceable advantages as a basic mode or approach in dynamic monitoring of land use. Dynamic monitoring of land use by remote sensing application and GIS technology has advantages of less time consumption, strong maneuverability and reliable data. In the paper, Chenggong District of Kunming is regarded as the study area. Remote sensing technology is relied for classification analysis on TM images from 2000 to 2015. Dynamic changes of land use in Chenggong District within recent 15 years are studied. Dynamic change laws thereof are analyzed, thereby providing effective guidance for rational use of land in Chenggong District under the background of novel urbanization.

articleTitle: Research of Sub-Regional Grid Dispatching Based on Different Objectives
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: A network model of multi-node connection based on different objectives is proposed to solve the problem of sub-regional power gird dispatching. The network model is based on the theory of complex network, consisting of power generation terminals, middle terminals, utilization terminals, connecting edges and so on. The network model is described both mathematically and graphically. Genetic algorithm is used to solve the two-regional numerical examples. The first region chooses minimum carbon emission as first sub-objective, while the other region chooses the combination of minimum purchase cost and minimum coal consumption as second sub-objective. Weighted method is used to transfer the two sub-objectives into a single objective. Result shows that proposed model can achieve sub-regional dispatching with sub-regions taking environmental and economic dispatch as objectives respectively.

articleTitle: An Intelligent System for English Pronunciation Correction
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: English pronunciation correction highly relies on the English teaching quality, therefore, in this paper, we propose a novel intelligent system for English pronunciation correction based on both Convolutional neural networks (CNN) and voiceprint proof. CNN refers to a multi-layer neural network, in which each layer contains multiple 2D planes and each plane is made up of a lot of independent neurons. We read the voice signal of speakers in advance, and then handle the original voices based on the CNN model. Then, the MFCC features are extracted and input to the CNN and voiceprint recognition is achieved by analyzing the output of CNN. Afterwards, English pronunciations are corrected through comparing the voiceprint of the target user to the standard pronunciation. Finally, experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method is able to achieve high voiceprint recognition rate for various experiment settings.

Author Keywords: English pronunciation, Voiceprint proof, Convolutional neural networks, Kernel

articleTitle: Study on the System Dynamics Model of Low Carbon City Development
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Low-carbon economy has received extensive attention from all walks of life, as a new change of human economic development mode.In order to promote the sustainable development of the future society, economy, energy and environment, this paper designs a system dynamics model for the development of low carbon cities based on the urban low carbon economic indicators.Vensim software is adopted to test the system dynamics model, through the calculation of relative error between actual value and simulation value, and the model can be considered to be effective.Combined with the development of low carbon economy in Nanjing in the next 5 years, the development of low carbon economy in the city is simulated, and the feasible path of low carbon city construction is obtained.

articleTitle: Analysis on Operating Current Threshold of Atmosphere Controlled Container Environment Regulation System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to study the logic judgment basis for the fault diagnosis of atmosphere controlled container environment regulation system, an experimental platform for atmosphere controlled container environment regulation system is built, and the working current monitoring test of the equipment is carried out. The working current of the electric ball valve, the fan and the solenoid valve of the typical actuator and the threshold of the fault diagnosis are analyzed. The results show that: (1) the current threshold of the opening process of the electric ball valve is 0.033A~0.113A, the current threshold of the holding process is 0.01A~0.025A, the threshold of the closing process is 0.015A~0.095A, and the current threshold of the process is 0.002A~0.01A after closing. (2) when PWM is 0%~20%, the characteristic equation of the normal working current of the fan is 0.002x2+0.013x; when PWM is 20%~100%, the characteristic equation of the normal working current of the fan is 0.003x+1.265. (3) the normal working current thresholds of solenoid valves and humidifier are 0.42A~0.51A and 0.44A~0.53A respectively. The results of experiment and analysis can provide references for the study of fault diagnosis decision making for transport equipment with modified atmosphere.

articleTitle: Design of Remote Multi-feedback System for Low-Temperature Distribution Box Based on Mobile Network Platform
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to study the remote monitoring and control of the "the last kilometer" low-temperature distribution link of the cold chain logistics of agricultural products, a prototype platform of the low-temperature distribution box which is complementary to the semiconductor refrigeration and the cold storage source is set up. On the basis of the environment control system in the box, taking STM32 as the control core, this paper designs a remote multi-feedback system in low-temperature distribution box, which consists of lithium battery, power supply voltage regulator, control core, serial touch screen, active crystal, reset circuit, communication circuit, GSM module and mobile phone mobile terminal. Through the hardware circuit design and the software task programming, realized the data information of the environment temperature, relative humidity, the temperature of the pulp, the surface temperature of the cold storage plate, the location of the distribution box and so on, and the information of the refrigeration compressor, the cooling pump of the semiconductor hot end, the semiconductor refrigeration film, the axial fan and so on have been remote monitored and early warned. The above design can provide reference for the research of remote monitoring system for cold chain logistics low-temperature distribution equipment.

articleTitle: A Novel Intelligent Modern Art Design Method Based on Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: As is well known that traditional cultural elements play an important role in the modern art design. In this paper, we demonstrate on how to effectively use traditional cultural elements in modern art design with Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO). Particularly, we extract three types of traditional cultural elements, such as Chinese character, Auspicious pattern, and Folk Art. The most important problem of this work is how to determine the importance of each type of cultural element. Furthermore, the main innovation of this paper lies in that we utilize particle swarm optimization to solve the modern art design problem. We have utilized the proposed method in modern art design, and experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method can effectively promote the quality of modern art design.

Author Keywords: Modern art design, Traditional cultural element, Chinese character, Intelligent computing, Particle Swarm Optimization

articleTitle: Study on Regional Differences of Population Urbanization in Yunnan Province Based on the Analysis of Census Big Data
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In this paper, analyzes the spatial differences of population urbanization in yunnan province based on the big data of population census in relevant years. The analysis results show that, in terms of province, the urbanization in remain at a higher rate in such regions of central Yunnan province, while a lower one in western, southwestern, northeastern regions; in terms of prefecture and city, the capitals of prefectures and cities develop a relatively higher urbanization rate, while a lower in the regions away from the capital. In terms of county, it develops a sharper disparity among counties.

articleTitle: Friction State Recognition of Mechanical Seal Face Dependent on Adaptive Neuro Fuzzy Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to ensure the compatibility and balance of the low friction and small leakage of mechanical seal, a kind of friction state recognition of mechanical seal face dependent on adaptive neuro fuzzy (hereinafter referred to as ANFA for short) is put forward. In this algorithm, the variable neighborhood algorithm is combined with the PM mechanical seal face friction state recognition, which has overcome the defects that are existing in the traditional mechanical seal face frictional state recognition. Finally, simulation comparison is carried out on the proposed algorithm and the VNM algorithm, which has verified that the algorithm put forward in this paper can quickly identify the friction state of the mechanical seal face in the working process.

articleTitle: Multilevel Fuzzy Evaluation Based Application Research on Intelligent Teaching System in College Class
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Since single evaluation method is inefficient, establishing a teaching quality evaluation algorithm with real-time optimization and intelligent learning becomes a major trend for current automatic evaluation. Based on the study of evaluation index system of classroom teaching quality in colleges, this paper proposes an intelligent evaluation model for the quality of classroom teaching in colleges and applies it to evaluation practice of intelligent teaching system. It avoids the problem of difficult determination on weights a and simplifies the evaluation process. The improved multilevel fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method is adopted to perform evaluation on the quality of classroom teaching. The case analysis shows that the model is an effective method to evaluate the quality of classroom teaching in colleges, and it realizes the high efficiency, network and intelligence of the teaching quality evaluation.

articleTitle: Teaching Methods of Colleges and Universities Based on Intelligent Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to improve the intelligentized level of high efficiency teaching, a teaching optimization method based on intelligent information technology is proposed. The optimized intelligent information processing technology of college teaching includes the module of teaching resource information dispatching, the database module and the intelligent information processing module, and the design of the teaching resource information scheduling model of universities and colleges. The adaptive feedback equilibrium configuration method is used to optimize the allocation of teaching resources in Colleges and universities. Based on the fuzzy partition scheduling method, the intelligent processing of teaching information in Colleges and universities is carried out. The access model of the university teaching resources distributed large database is constructed, and the university teaching large database access and information retrieval are adopted by the driver configuration program. The intelligent information processing technology is used to optimize the teaching methods of colleges and universities. The test results show that this method is used to optimize the design of teaching methods in Colleges and universities, the ability to dispatch and balance the information of teaching resources in Colleges and universities is improved, the intelligent information management of College teaching is realized, it has the higher intelligence level of the teaching methods and the stronger ability of information processing than traditional method.

articleTitle: Calculation and Analysis of Pile-Cap in a Cable-Stayed Bridge with Single Pylon
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Pile-cap is the main load bearing component in the bridge substructure. It has the function of connecting the superstructure and substructure, so its safety is quite crucial. And in the pile foundation, the behavior of pile-cap under force is complicated. In this paper, a highway cable-stayed bridge is taken as an example. The computation of the pile-cap in this bridge has been conducted based on the method in the specifications, including the bearing capacity computation of normal section, sloping section and punching resistance. And the bearing capacity of normal section has been computed based on the strut-tie theory. The punching resistance capacity has been computed by pier punching downward and pile punching upward. According to the computation results, the bearing capacity of pile-cap's normal section, sloping section and punching resistance meet the requirements of specifications.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Innovation and Entrepreneurship Management System for College Graduates
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The employment problem of college graduates is urgently needed to be solved. In this paper, the development status, characteristics and requirements of College Students' innovation management system is proposed based on the nature and process of comprehensive employment work in Colleges and universities. The detailed design is analyzed to provide complete and reasonable scheme, and to solve the traditional electronic form the low efficiency problem of decentralized management. The system also realizes zero maintenance for users. It adopts Oracle database to storage the system data and develops the system integrated with data sharing and Internet technologies.

articleTitle: An Empirical Analysis of Japanese Teachers' Educational Ability Evaluation under the MOOC Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: As a novel production of the deep integration of information technology and education, MOOC plays an important role in foreign language teaching, especially Japanese teaching. Firstly, we propose a Japanese teaching quality evaluation index system, which contains four main parts, such as 1) Teaching attitude, 2) Teaching content, 3) Teaching method and teaching ability, and 4) Teaching effectiveness. Secondly, to determine the weight for each factor in the proposed system, we introduce the Analytic Hierarchy Process technology, which can achieve a priority of the importance of each alternative. In particular, in AHP, an overall object is located at the top level, and the criteria in the middle level refer to the overall object. Finally, the proposed method can evaluate Japanese teachers' educational ability under the MOOC environment with high accuracy.

Author Keywords: Empirical analysis, Japanese teaching, Educational ability, MOOC environment, Analytic Hierarchy Process

articleTitle: Quantitative Analysis System of College Counselors' Work Assessment Based on Cluster Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: This paper studies the ideological and political education in the management of Ideological and political education in Colleges and universities, and combines the K mean algorithm in cluster analysis to analyze the assessment and quantification of the counselors' work. Based on the instructor's certification system, the decision support system of college counselors is designed. The results show that the quantitative system of College Counselors' work assessment based on cluster analysis can effectively excavate some valuable data and help to improve the management level of Ideological and political education.

articleTitle: Integral Calculation of a Cable-Stayed Bridge with Single Pylon
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In this paper, the actual project of cable-stayed bridge with single pylon is taken as the calculation object. This bridge has main span of 2 × 132m, and it is tower-girder consolidation system. The finite element model is established using Midas/civil software to calculate and analyze the bridge's behavior in construction and service status. The calculation includes the force calculation of the main girder, the central pylon and cables; also includes cracking resistance and stiffness checking computation of main girder in the serviceability limit state, the stress checking computation of the main girder, the central pylon and stay-cables also in the serviceability limit state. Calculations results prove that the bridge's static force performance meets the specification requirements both in the construction and service status. So it can provide a reference for the design scheme selection and calculation analysis of similar bridges.

articleTitle: Development and Implementation of Entrepreneurial Management System for College Students Based on B/S Structure
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Based on analysis of current college students' entrepreneurial item features this paper provides college students with a resource-shared and rapidly autonomous learning platform. The platform can realize rational management and effective reuse in entrepreneurial item resource and provide a window for commercial transformation in excellent entrepreneurial item. This article adopts SSH2 frame-based B/S framework, and discusses a set of reliable, feasible and expansible system design and realization possibility of college students' entrepreneurial resource base. Meanwhile, it analyzes the involved key modules during construction and offers solutions intensively. After testing analysis, the students entrepreneurial management system effectively offers all functions involving request analysis, improves management process in students' entrepreneurial items, effectively improves work efficiency in students' entrepreneurial training project and realizes multidimensional data query in entrepreneurial management.

articleTitle: Development and Application of Visual Network Management System for Campus Based on B/S Architecture
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to improve development efficiency in system of business platform networked management, enrich function in network management system, enhance easy-use and applicability in network management system, this paper studies system frame, function and corresponding development technology in network management system, and also puts forward a B/S framework-based model in visualized network management system in terms of campus network characteristics. Furthermore, this paper studies the system structure in general network management, development method of simple networked management protocol, development method of SVG and AJAX, and finally solves key problems of design and development in general network management system. The test results show that our model can effectively support secure operation on campus network platform and accord with networked management system development trend in terms of functional advantages of general network management system on traditional network management.

articleTitle: Face Recognition Based on LBEP Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In this paper, based on the analysis of the traditional LBP algorithm, proposed local binary average entropy pattern (LBEP) algorithm, and then designed the face recognition process based on LBEP algorithm, given different weights to different regions of the recognition effect and weighted arithmetic, finally the experiment results show that compared with the traditional LBP algorithm the LBEP algorithm, the recognition rate improved significantly.

articleTitle: Pilot-Plant Test on the Hot Air Drying inPotato Staple Foods
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: in order to develop staple potato products suitable for our country, in this paper, based on the previous research of thin layer drying, used box-type ventilation drying machine to carry out the pilot test of potato, and the tested the quality of dry samples. The research results show that the dry products has better color, no obvious browning and products of starch pasting does not occur, DSC test curvehas cave peak of, the absorbent is 211.67%, the gelatinization degree is 23.27%, dry products have low degree of maturation; When using diesel and coal as fuel, the cost of producing 1t potato dried products is 14417 yuan and 12094 yuan respectively, of which the cost of raw materials accounted for 72.83% and 86.82% respectively. The research of this paper provides the theoretical basis for the production and processing of potato grain.

articleTitle: Service Oriented Logistics Supply Chain Management Process Optimization:A Case Study of Agriculture Product Company
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In this article, an agricultural product company X is taken as the research object. Theoretical knowledge of supply chain and the achievements of relevant exploration and practice at home and abroad are adopted to provide optimization of logistics supply chain fox X company, with expected results and safeguards needed to be taken. According to current survey and data collection of the company, we clarify the current situation and existing problems of logistics supply chain, and perform demand analysis of logistics supply chain optimization. Then, based the actual situation of the survey data, the optimized scheme for original logistics process is proposed. ABC classification management is used for inventory optimization and the optimal design of transportation and distribution management is also proposed. Finally the advice and design of major function modules to establish intelligent logistics supply chain information system is put forward to provide theoretical direction for the optimization of X company.

articleTitle: Energy Optimized Node Mobility Optimization Strategy for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Mobile sensors need to move back and forth in the monitoring area. Its energy consumption is very large, and the energy is difficult to replenish. Therefore, it becomes a hotspot on saving energy and prolonging the life cycle of the network. In this paper, we divide the sensor network into several independent grids, and establish a grid based localization strategy for mobile sink nodes. When the sink node moves within a single grid, the location update process will be limited to this grid; when the sink node moves out of a front grid, the converging node only need to broadcast its new grid number in the network due to grid based network structure. Then, the optimal placement strategy of energy is constructed through linear optimization model. The simulation results show that these two aspects can greatly reduce the energy consumption during the location update process and improve the network performance.

articleTitle: Graphic Design of Science and Technology Park Based on Analysis of Functional Elements
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Science and technology park is a gathering place for high and new technology industry and its planning and design is different from common parks in many factors. As the construction basis, graphic design can promote the uniqueness and integrity of a cultural industry block, to highlight the location value. This article takes the case of the graphic design project of a science and technology park in Shanghai as an example, and adopts design method of system layout to make planning research on its total plane layout. By analysis of the functional elements including planning and layout, vertical design and building height, traffic organization and design, greening and landscape design and other functional elements, corresponding solution and the advice of resource sharing are provided. Then, the position correlation graph is drawn to form an overall optimization of the layout scheme, which can be taken as basis and reference for other similar project design.

articleTitle: Research on Fast Collision Detection Algorithm Based on CPU Cache Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In recent years, with the rising of virtual reality, distributed, parallel, and other technologies, collision detection has been being popular research issues. In the face of the huge computation of the collision detection, many experts and scholars at home and abroad throw themselves into algorithm studies, combing the latest computer technology and their own knowledge, to meet the real-time and accuracy of the algorithm based on a wide range of exploration, and enable them to universal applicability for collision detection of development, pointed out the new research direction for it as well.From the perspective of dealing with large complex scenes, this paper presents a insensitive virtual scene. The basic idea is to use the advantages of GPU graphics processor and gets the conclusions of the collision between the objects by caching technology to analyze images of objects in a scene. For it is not sensitive to the image scene, it is very favorable for the collision detection in large-complex scenes.

articleTitle: A Novel Artwork Design Method Based on Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: How to fully the big data technology to improve the performance of artwork design is of great importance in computer vision. In this paper, we propose a novel artwork design method based on big data technology. Firstly, we provide an overview of the big data technology, which is made up of data acquisition and cloud application technology, data processing and distributed processing technology, data storage and storage technology, and data formation results and perception technology. Secondly, we discuss how to design the artwork product using the big data technology, and the proposed method is implemented by surface deformation, which is solved by an optimization problem. Finally, some examples are given to show that the proposed method can achieve realistic effects and can fully exploit the big data technology and computer vision technology to generate high quality artwork design.

Author Keywords: artwork design, big data, surface modeling, surface deformation

articleTitle: Design of Foreign Language Teachers' Teaching Language Teaching Evaluation Model Based on Association Mining
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to improve the quality of foreign language teachers' teaching evaluation, a teaching language teaching evaluation model based on association rule mining is proposed, which combines the data analysis method with the optimization design of the teaching language quantitative evaluation model. A time series analysis model of the statistical data flow of foreign language teachers' teaching language teaching evaluation is constructed, and the data structure of foreign language teachers' teaching language evaluation is analyzed. The phase space of the statistical data of foreign language teaching evaluation is reconstructed, and the association rule feature of foreign language teacher teaching language teaching evaluation is extracted in the reconstructed phase space. The extracted features are used as the clustering center for information fusion and the adaptive regression analysis is used to realize the optimal design of the teaching evaluation model. The simulation results show that this method can improve the accuracy of teaching evaluation of foreign language teachers, and the whole evaluation process has good convergence and strong anti-interference ability.

articleTitle: Research on Machining Technology for Fatigue Fracture of Burrs on Cross-Drilled Holes of Master Cylinder
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In this paper, fluid impact-based fatigue fracture method is used to remove burrs. Mathematical models of flow field and burr are established, and modeling for flow field at cross-drilled holes on a machined part is conducted. Based on situation of burrs generated during actual machining process, actual burrs are simplified and a corresponding mechanical model is established, on which a finite-element analysis is completed to obtain optimal technical parameters for machining technology for realizing fatigue fracture of burrs on cross-drilled holes of the master cylinder and thus improve efficiency and quality of machining of brake master cylinder.

Author Keywords: Burrs on Cross-drilled Holes of Master Cylinder

articleTitle: Property Manager Service Platform Based on Android
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The development of the property manager service platform based on Android is to enhance the relationship between the user and the property company. In the present social news, there are many contradictions between the users and the property managers. The fundamental reason is that the property does not deal well with the relationship between the user and the property. When the user found the problem, the property did not receive their information and deal with it in time. The property manager service platform based on Android provides a good platform. The property can be processed through the information submitted by the user, and the speed of the property handling affairs is further improved.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Overtaking Rules Based on AHP
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In recent years, the frequent occurrence of traffic accidents on expressway and the great economic loss are the hot issues of road safety. In order to study the traffic condition of low load and high load, the influence of "on right pass, from left overtaking" rule to improve the traffic condition of expressway, such as improving traffic flow, improving safety and increasing the demand satisfaction rate; two mathematical models were established to analyze the factors affecting traffic condition. In addition, by using the model results, the effect of overtaking on the traffic flow is evaluated by the analytic hierarchy process.

articleTitle: An Feasibility Analysis of English Intelligent Digitization Teaching Based on the Multi-storage Model of Fusion Memory
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: At present, only the relationship of the teaching feasibility of words is considered in the mainstream English teaching method, but such things as the content collocation of English teaching is not. In this paper, the method of the feasibility analysis of the English intelligent digital teaching fusing memory multiple storage model is proposed. Memory multiple storage model is introduced in this method in English intelligent digital teaching and it includes teaching feasibility information, intelligent digital teaching and other English teaching content collocation information. The experimental results show that the accuracy and recall rate of this method are 88.76% and 87.43% respectively, and the comprehensive index f value is 6.65% higher than the teaching feasibility analysis of memory multiple storage model.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Construction Land Ecological Suitability in Chenggong District of Kunming Based on Big Date
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Urban construction is also increased rapidly with rapid development of modern society, which is also accompanied by damages of ecological environment and irrational construction land. In the paper, Kunming Chenggong District is adopted as an example aiming at the problem. Supervision classification, buffer analysis, overlay analysis and other related methods are adopted for evaluating the ecological adaptability of construction land in Chenggong district based on big date, using GIS and RS technology, thereby providing certain suggestions for Chenggong Development from ecological perspective.

articleTitle: Hopf Bifurcation in a Delay-Diffusive Holling-Tanner Predator-Prey Model with Smith Growth
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In this paper, we chiefly take the stability and Hopf bifurcation of a diffusive Holling-Tanner predator-prey model with Smith growth and delay into consideration. Firstly, we analyze the local stability of the system, the existence of Hopf bifurcation in the co-existence of the equilibrium process. Furthermore, with help of normal formal theory and center manifold theorem, the stability of bifurcating periodic solutions and the direction of Hopf bifurcation are established. Finally, we prove the effectiveness of the theoretical analysis through numerical simulations, and rich dynamical behavior of the diffusive predator-prey system.

articleTitle: Research on the Failure Criterion of Snow-Ice Constitutive Model
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Solid ice-snow is the collection of impurities and ice-snow particles with adhesion and cohesive force after covering the ground, such as the external load and environmental factors. The destruction of ice-snow and the mechanism of removal determine the difficulty degree of ice-snow removal. Firstly, the constitutive model of ice-snow was established. It is considered that the ice-snow are micro-neck links, and its characteristics mainly depend on the binding properties between ice-snow particles. Secondly, the failure process of solid ice-snow is analyzed by high-speed camera. It is found that the failure mode of solid ice-snow is mainly brittle fracture, and the failure process involves three stages: cutting peeling and contacting. Finally, the failure criterion is established based on the solid ice-snow constitutive model, the form of ice-snow failure and the failure process. Besides considering the tool parameters, the friction factor, snow density and compressive strength, Young modulus, friction angle and the other factors are taken into account due to the temperature change. The establishment of the failure criteria provides a practical reference and theoretical basis for the removal of solid ice-snow.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of An Intelligent System for Ideological and Political Education Learning under The MOOC Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: To solve the problem of low efficiency in traditional ideological and political teaching and students' passive acceptance of ideological and political education, this paper designs and develops an intelligent system for MOOC based teaching platform. It is based on ASP.NET framework system and divided into interface layer, service layer and data layer. According to functional requirement analysis in system, divided into four major functional modules, this system realizes information management in ideological and political teaching, stimulates students' learning interest and finally improves efficiency in ideological and political teaching to a large extent. By multiple times of tests, the intelligent system is stable in operation and each function is correctly responded to satisfy initial design requirement.

articleTitle: Study on the Evaluation Model of Teaching Satisfaction in Colleges and Universities
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Customer satisfaction theory, as a scientific and systematic theory, has been widely used in the nonprofit organization by the industry with more and more attention.The evaluation of teaching satisfaction in Colleges and universities is of great significance to the improvement of teaching quality. On the premise of studying the student satisfaction index system of teaching quality, this paper proposes a teaching quality evaluation model based on the theory of customer satisfaction. The empirical research results show that the model can accurately reflect students' satisfaction with teaching quality.

articleTitle: Construction of Real Estate Business Prosperity Monitoring System Considering Fuzzy Group Analytic Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The fuzzy group analytic hierarchy process has the typical characteristics such as distribution, heterogeneity and privacy of the real estate business prosperity monitoring data. A kind of construction method for the real estate business prosperity monitoring system which takes the fuzzy group analytic hierarchy process (hereinafter referred to as FGAHP for short) into consideration is put forward in this paper. In view of the construction problem of the real estate business prosperity monitoring system, the fuzzy group analysis method is used to determine the critical value of the state area of each index. The results show that the system constructed considering the fuzzy group analytic hierarchy process method can basically reflect the real estate situation in China in recent years, which can reduce the computational complexity of the real estate business prosperity monitoring data.

Author Keywords: Real Estate Business Prosperity Monitoring System
